description: Multi-agent LLM desk after TradingAgents (Xiao, Sun, Luo & Wang 2024, arXiv:2412.20138), cut to a bounded daily cost: code builds a fact sheet (returns, SMA50/200, ATR20, trend state, defanged headlines) for the 3 candidates with the strongest volatility-scaled 20-day momentum among SPY/QQQ/GLD/TLT/BTC/ETH and the day's 3 strongest sector ETFs; a Bull and a Bear analyst argue, rebut once, and a Risk-manager judge returns strict JSON (enter_long / enter_short / no_trade, confidence, hold 5-30 days). Stops (3 x ATR20) and sizes are code. 15 Flash calls, ~24k tokens a day.
output_character: 0-3 daily long/short calls on liquid ETFs and BTC/ETH, 5-30 day hold chosen by an LLM judge, ATR disaster stop by code
public_data_sources: public daily price bars via gateway.price_history (complete bars only)
code-computed trend states data/trend/<date>.json (marketmind.trend, pure code)
public news titles from the Playground context (untrusted, defanged)
author: MarketMind (owner decision 2026-09-29)
